digest.component_or_area: documentation and repository metadata batch F08–F20
propositions: Documentation for current claim, relation, unlink, help, and close behaviors must be corrected and aligned with implementations.
Installation dependencies, Git requirements, operation certificates, and import guidance must be documented and distinguished from legacy records.
All top-level routes must be discoverable through help forms and MCP summaries must emit complete, correct transition semantics.
Configuration contract generation through F19 children must remove nonexistent claims, generate descriptions for every typed key, and correct diagnostic guidance.
GitHub About description must be updated to lead with enforceable plan review and signed completion verification, verified through authenticated readback.
All eight repository children must merge independently to origin/main with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments before closure without force.
